description: Source code for the PTM driver core functions for the Lantiq VR9 platform, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and control of PP32 cores.

methods.name: init_pmu
methods.description: Initializes Power Management Unit by enabling specific modules.

methods.name: reset_ppe
methods.description: Resets the PPE hardware components via reset controls.

methods.name: init_mailbox
methods.description: Initializes mailbox registers for inter-processor communication.

methods.name: init_atm_tc
methods.description: Initializes ATM traffic control and related registers.

methods.name: pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware binary code to the PP32 core.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the PTM chip including PMU, reset, DMA, mailbox, and buffer.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Starts the PP32 core by downloading firmware and releasing freeze.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_stop
methods.description: Stops the PP32 core by asserting freeze.
